authority: Darren approved cumulative acceptance and merge preparation. PyPI release, production activation, and Scholialang-cloud propagation remain separate gates.
evidence_contract: Test the combined immutable candidate from a clean export; verify ancestry, remote parity, cross-PRD interfaces, full regression, protocol evidence, rollback refs, and public-evidence hygiene.
title: Cumulative MCP acceptance and merge package
problem: Individual implementation proofs do not establish that the combined MCP artifact is coherent or ready for downstream consumers.
outcome: One independently adjudicated cumulative MCP candidate is prepared for the approved merge decision.
hard_constraints: All accepted predecessor tips remain ancestral or are explicitly reconciled.
Run combined tests from a clean export.
Downstream OT work remains receipt-gated until this candidate is accepted.
Preserve report-only trace caveats and historical evidence.

stories.title: Cumulative regression
stories.description: Run the full combined MCP and protocol battery against the final cumulative tip.

stories.title: Independent adjudication
stories.description: Verify exact SHA, branch lineage, remote parity, tests, wire evidence, and hygiene.

stories.title: Merge package
stories.description: Prepare rollback, downstream handoff, and one consolidated operator decision package.

acceptance: Combined candidate passes all required tests and real adapter checks.
All caveats are explicit and non-blocking or named as blockers.
Exact final SHA and rollback ref are recorded.
One merge-ready package is published for review.
verification: Run cumulative clean-export tests and independent PM adjudication; stop before any release or Cloud propagation.
rollback: Provide exact revert/branch rollback instructions and preserve each predecessor receipt.
